_provenance.source_repo_note: The entire data that powers ashtadhyayi.com. Credit required. Direct edits of commentaries/dhātu/śabda discouraged — use the site edit button.

learner_front_end.role: Teaching UI over ashtadhyayi.com corpus + vidyut_prakriya.wasm. Provenance-tag convention (engine-computed / corpus-quoted / editorial). Not a second pāṭha and not a runtime resolver. Generated JSON (index/sutras.json etc.) is often unpublished; the database behind it is ashtadhyayi-com/data.

_provenance.local_checkout: ashtadhyayi.com data-master (iCloud Panini_sanskrit) — mirror of the GitHub repo
_provenance.note: Catalog of granthas the engine is allowed to *cite*. Only paribhāṣā granthas may decide a runtime conflict (Art. 21). Ārthika granthas never pick a winner.

databases.role: Abhyāsa / pāṭha / prakriyā UI. Uses ashtadhyayi-com/data + Vidyut wasm. Copy provenance tags, not rule logic (Art. 0, Art. 19).

paribhasha_granthas.author: नागेशभट्ट
paribhasha_granthas.role: Executable meta-rules for vipratipatti (PŚ 38 ladder and its exceptions).

sk_tika_granthas.author: नागेशभट्ट
sk_tika_granthas.role: Nāgeśa on the Siddhānta-Kaumudī. Design-time reading of a sūtra (e.g. 1.1.44 विभाषा). Never rearranges kram (Art. 3). Excerpts the resolver names live under paribhasha_shekhara.json laghu_excerpts.

arthika_granthas.author: भर्तृहरि
arthika_granthas.role: śabda-tattva / sphoṭa. Domain-limited; not a vipratipatti authority.
